name: set_meeting_config
title: Set meeting config
description: Update the processing configuration of a meeting (manifest.config) and optionally its scope. Only the keys you pass change; omitted keys keep their current value. `self_name` and `new_scope` accept null to clear them. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its current scope in the request), `new_scope` is the value to store — changing a meeting's scope therefore requires covering its current scope first, and every scope change is audit-logged with the old and new value. Engine and provider names must be registry names reported by get_server_info. The selected llm_provider / engines are checked against the resulting external_send_policy (local_only → only engines and providers that keep data on this machine; subscription_ok → additionally subscription providers such as claude-agent-sdk; api_ok → everything) and a conflicting combination is rejected with policy_violation instead of silently falling back. Changing the config does not regenerate anything — call regenerate afterwards (it re-runs exactly the stages whose parameters changed). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key. Returns the full effective config and scope. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), busy (a job is queued / running for the meeting; its manifest cannot be changed underneath it), policy_violation, engine_unavailable (name not registered on this server), invalid_argument, internal.

transcription_engine.description: Registry name: auto | fake | mlx-whisper | faster-whisper (see get_server_info.capabilities.transcription_engines).

llm_provider.description: Registry name: none | fake | claude-agent-sdk | anthropic-api | ollama (see get_server_info.capabilities.llm_providers). none = plain minutes without LLM.

external_send_policy.description: What may leave this machine. Providers/engines that conflict with it are rejected.

language.description: Transcription language code, e.g. ja or en.

self_name.description: Display name for the microphone speaker (label me). null clears it.

vocab_hints.description: Domain vocabulary (product names, people) passed to transcription and integration. Replaces the current list.

new_scope.description: New affiliation scope of the meeting; null makes it unscoped. Omit to leave unchanged. The request's `scope` selector must cover the meeting's current scope.

config.description: Full effective config after the update.

scope.description: Effective scope after the update (null = unscoped).
